n/GOALS.md\":{\"sha256\":\"373b460ff66fb9bf68c1ea8ce699291efdf5fd49d2c2e43425927e8e77687d18\"},\"specification/INTENT.md\":{\"sha256\":\"d5d433896a50370a023126e60a170a0c9e3b0920d1489b4ea27a30d56670d0e1\"},\"specification/PRODUCT.md\":{\"sha256\":\"ff4546f54cbc888373c8d7b50ca485999d951b13aecd4d597ffd095be60044a2\"},\"specification/REQUIREMENT.md\":{\"sha256\":\"48a34de6cf1ea24dc661d0c6f730bf2c21f6791bc4a9cdee1a6b46d3aa8548d9\"},\"unrelated/sentinel.txt\":{\"sha256\":\"56686d9c77cc9592aee6e2e4514fe02a7f59daa3c0befced80b3980bc6cb51b3\"}}
